title: Sometimes Even Reality Is a Lie!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schooler Kaoru Terazaki plays a female character in an online game and befriends a player he assumes is a man, until they meet and he learns Nami is Nanami Osaka, a reclusive girl who plays a male avatar. Her overprotective father won't allow male friends, so Kaoru dresses as a girl to visit her home. With his encouragement Nanami returns to school, and the two edge toward romance while her parents grow alongside her.
life_message: It holds up friendship that sees the real person behind the avatar, and families that learn to trust.
